about: Public Chicago events for the weekends after October 28, 2026, plus the Thanksgiving parade and the Thalia Hall comedy dates. Each item was checked against a public listing. Neighborhood pins are used only when a city release named the neighborhood and did not publish a street address. Route pins mark a parade corridor, not a single entrance.

events.name: Haunted Halsted Halloween Fest & Parade
events.time: Fest at noon; parade at 7:00 p.m.; costume contest at 8:00 p.m.
events.venue: Halsted Street between Aldine Avenue and Addison Avenue
events.address: Halsted St between Aldine Ave and Addison Ave, Chicago, IL
events.summary: The 30th Haunted Halsted Halloween Parade is an all-day street fest this year, with vendors, music, and family activities from noon, the parade at 7 p.m., and a costume contest at 8. Admission is free. The event occupies Halsted between Aldine and Addison.
events.transitNote: Halsted Street between Aldine Avenue and Addison Avenue is the festival footprint and the parade route.

events.name: Upside Down Halloween Parade
events.summary: Seventh edition of the Upside Down Halloween Parade, presented by LUMA8 and the City of Chicago. Families in costume walk Russell Drive in Washington Park while dancers, puppets, and other entertainment line the path.

sources.name: City of Chicago Fall Fest release

events.name: Fall Fest at Lincoln Park Zoo
events.summary: Fall Fest's Friday through Sunday schedule runs through November 1. Zoo admission is free. Ticketed pieces include the Giant Fun Slide, a Ferris wheel, and a fall fun zone, alongside the pumpkin patch, s'mores, and weekend entertainment.
events.admission: Free zoo admission; some rides ticketed

events.name: Pilsen Día de los Muertos Window Walk
events.time: Weekend of October 30–November 1; hours were not listed in the roundup.
events.venue: 18th Street between Damen Avenue and Halsted Street
events.address: W 18th St between Damen Ave and Halsted St, Chicago, IL
events.summary: The Pilsen Chamber of Commerce's Día de los Muertos Window Walk along the 18th Street commercial corridor, between Damen and Halsted. The pin marks the corridor, not a single storefront.

events.name: Sanctum Dark Music Festival
events.time: 7:00 p.m. both nights
events.venue: Thalia Hall and the Tack Room
events.summary: Two nights of darkwave, industrial, and post-punk at Thalia Hall, with more sets in the downstairs Tack Room. Hall shows are 17+; the Tack Room is 21+. The festival's stated costume theme is blasphemy.
events.transitNote: Thalia Hall's own note: street parking is tight; the hall is served by CTA, and meter parking is nearby.

events.name: Día de los Muertos at Navy Pier
events.time: Saturday, November 1; hours were not listed in the roundup.
events.summary: Navy Pier's Día de los Muertos program, listed by Choose Chicago as art and cultural activities marking the day.

events.name: Halloween trick-or-treating at Navy Pier
events.time: Halloween, October 31
events.summary: Trick-or-treating along Navy Pier on Halloween. Choose Chicago's Slightly Spooky October note also lists free Crystal Gardens movies on October 17 and 24, which are already past.

events.name: Seadog Haunted River Tour
events.time: October 30–31; departure times were not in the roundup.
events.summary: Seasonal Seadog haunted cruise on the Chicago River, departing from City Cruises at Navy Pier on October 30 and 31.

events.name: House of the Exquisite Corpse VI: Lullabies
events.time: Fri–Sat entries every 15 minutes, 6:50–9:30 p.m.; Sunday 1:50–3:50 p.m.
events.venue: Merle Reskin Garage at Steppenwolf Theatre
events.summary: Rough House Puppet Arts' horror-puppet show runs through November 1 in Steppenwolf's Merle Reskin Garage. Entry is timed, and the audience wears headphones. Pay what you can, with a $22–$47 suggested donation. Recommended for ages 13 and up.

events.name: The Book of Mormon
events.time: Engagement listed through November 1; performance times vary.
events.summary: Choose Chicago lists The Book of Mormon at the Cadillac Palace Theatre for a limited run from October 23 through November 1, which includes this weekend.

events.name: Don Giovanni
events.time: Listed for October 30–November 1; curtain times were not in the roundup.
events.summary: Lyric Opera opens its 2026/27 season with Don Giovanni. Choose Chicago lists the production for October 30 through November 1 at the Civic Opera House.

events.name: Stories We Wear: Fashion Film Festival Chicago
events.time: Sunday, November 1, afternoon
events.summary: Fashion Film Festival Chicago and the Chicago History Museum present an afternoon program on fashion as visual narrative.

events.name: DEATH TOLL
events.time: October 30–31; start time was not in the roundup.
events.summary: A returning Halloween sketch show at Cornservatory, listed by Choose Chicago for October 30 and 31.

events.name: Vampire Playlist
events.time: October 30–31; curtain time was not in the roundup.
events.summary: Vampire Playlist, part of Destinos: the 9th Chicago International Latino Theater Festival, at El Schomburg on Division Street.

events.name: Terror in the Tropics: Midnight in Mexico
events.time: October 31–November 1; hours were not in the roundup.
events.summary: Three Dots and a Dash takes over Salon 61 for Terror in the Tropics: Midnight in Mexico. Choose Chicago lists October 31 and November 1.

events.name: Fall-4-All: Belmont Cragin
events.time: October 30; a start time was not in the city release.
events.summary: One of the city's Fall-4-All stops during Chicago Fall Fest: a DJ, free food, resources, and activities. The announced partners are the 30th and 36th Wards. The release names the neighborhood and does not give a street address, so the pin is the neighborhood center.

sources.name: City of Chicago Fall Fest release

events.name: Fall-4-All: East Side
events.time: October 30; a start time was not in the city release.
events.summary: Fall-4-All community stop in East Side, with Giving Others Dreams as the announced partner. The city describes these events as a DJ, free food, resources, and activities. No street address was published, so the pin is the neighborhood center.

sources.name: City of Chicago Fall Fest release

events.name: Fall-4-All: Greater Grand Crossing
events.time: October 31; a start time was not in the city release.
events.summary: Fall-4-All community stop in Greater Grand Crossing, with Future Ties as the announced partner. Format described by the city: DJ, free food, resources, and activities. The pin is the neighborhood center because no street address was published.

sources.name: City of Chicago Fall Fest release

events.name: Fall-4-All: Garfield Park
events.time: October 31; a start time was not in the city release.
events.summary: Fall-4-All community stop in Garfield Park, with Youth Guidance and partners. The city describes a DJ, free food, resources, and activities. The pin is the park and neighborhood center; a street address was not in the release.

sources.name: City of Chicago Fall Fest release

events.name: Fall-4-All: Little Village
events.time: November 6; a start time was not in the city release.
events.summary: Fall-4-All community stop in Little Village, with Beyond the Ball as the announced partner. Same city format: DJ, free food, resources, and activities. The pin is the neighborhood center.

sources.name: City of Chicago Fall Fest release

events.name: Black Harvest Film Festival
events.time: November 6–15; individual screening times are on the festival schedule.
events.summary: The 32nd Black Harvest Film Festival, the School of the Art Institute of Chicago's annual showcase of Black cinema, at the Gene Siskel Film Center. The run covers the November 6 and November 13 weekends.

events.name: South Side Health & Wellness Fest
events.time: Walk at 9:00 a.m.; resources 10:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
events.address: 8560 S Cottage Grove Ave, Chicago, IL
events.summary: Free fest hosted by Block Club Chicago with more than 25 community partners. A neighborhood walk starts at 9 a.m., then blood-pressure checks, insurance help, exercise sessions, and other resources run until 3 p.m. Advance registration is encouraged.

events.name: Festival of Wood & Barrel-Aged Beer
events.time: Friday 6:00–10:00 p.m. (early entry 5:00); Saturday 1:00–5:00 p.m. (early entry noon).
events.summary: The Illinois Craft Brewers Guild's Festival of Wood & Barrel-Aged Beer, with two tasting sessions of wood-aged beer, cider, mead, and perry at UIC's Credit Union 1 Arena.

events.name: Randolph Street Market Holiday Market
events.time: Saturday 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. (9:00 a.m. early buy); Sunday 10:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
events.summary: Indoor holiday edition of the Randolph Street Market vintage and antique fair: vendors, food, and music in the West Loop. General admission is $20 and covers both days; children 12 and under are free. The 9 a.m. Saturday early buy is a separate ticket.

events.name: City of Chicago Christmas Tree Lighting
events.time: Festivities at 4:00 p.m.; ceremony at 6:00 p.m.; lighting about 6:30 p.m., then fireworks.
events.venue: Millennium Park at Michigan Avenue and Washington Street
events.address: Michigan Ave and Washington St, Chicago, IL
events.summary: The 113th annual tree lighting. Viewing areas and screens fill Millennium Park, and the main stage is on Washington Street next to the Chicago Cultural Center. ABC7 broadcasts the ceremony live. The tree stays lit through January 10, 2027.
events.transitNote: Large downtown crowd in Millennium Park and along Washington Street, with fireworks after the lighting.

events.name: Millennium Park Holiday Market
events.time: Friday and Saturday noon–8:00 p.m.; Sunday noon–5:00 p.m.
events.summary: Free DCASE market of local makers on Chase Promenade North, open the same weekend the city tree is lit. More than 40 vendors were planned in the city's vendor call.
events.transitNote: Shares the Loop with the tree lighting on Friday and the Magnificent Mile parade on Saturday.

events.name: Christkindlmarket Chicago at Daley Plaza
events.time: Fri–Sat 11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; Sun–Thu 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. Thanksgiving and Christmas Eve 11:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
events.summary: 30th season of the free outdoor German-style market at Daley Plaza. It opens November 20 and runs through December 24. A second Chicago market is at Gallagher Way in Wrigleyville.
events.transitNote: Opens the same evening as the Millennium Park tree lighting, about two blocks west.

events.name: Christkindlmarket Wrigleyville at Gallagher Way
events.time: November 20–December 31. Daily hours were not repeated in the citywide guide.
events.summary: The Wrigleyville Christkindlmarket at Gallagher Way opens November 20 and runs through December 31. Choose Chicago's festival guide also places Winterland — rides and family activities — on Gallagher Way for those dates. Admission to the market is free.

events.name: Wintrust Magnificent Mile Lights Festival
events.time: Festival lane 11:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; parade 5:30 p.m.; fireworks 7:30 p.m.
events.venue: Michigan Avenue from Oak Street to Wacker Drive
events.summary: 35th Wintrust Magnificent Mile Lights Festival. The parade leaves Oak Street and Michigan Avenue at 5:30 p.m. and moves south to Wacker, lighting the avenue's trees as it goes, with fireworks at 7:30 p.m. The pin is on the route near Water Tower Place, not a single grandstand.
events.transitNote: The festival site says street closures begin as early as 3 p.m. The route is Michigan Avenue from Oak Street to Wacker Drive. DCASE lists the same route and a 5:30 p.m. start.

events.name: ZooLights at Lincoln Park Zoo
events.time: 4:30–9:00 p.m., last entry 8:00 p.m.
events.summary: Ticketed holiday lights at Lincoln Park Zoo, opening November 20 and running through January 3, 2027. The zoo's page lists closures on Thanksgiving (November 26) and on December 1, 8, 15, 24, and 25. It is open New Year's Eve and New Year's Day. Advance fixed-date tickets are listed at $7–$12; day-of fixed-date tickets are listed at $20.

events.name: Ice skating at McCormick Tribune Ice Rink
events.time: Season listed from November 20, 2026 into March 2027. Daily hours were not in the festival guide.
events.venue: McCormick Tribune Ice Rink, Millennium Park
events.summary: Choose Chicago lists the McCormick Tribune rink as opening November 20, 2026 and running into March 2027. That guide does not publish a closing day, so March 31 is only the filter bound used here.
events.admission: See the park for skate details

events.name: Kyle Kinane
events.time: 8:00 p.m. both nights
events.summary: Stand-up comic Kyle Kinane plays Thalia Hall on Monday, November 23 and Tuesday, November 24, 2026. Public listings put the show at 8:00 p.m. both nights.

events.name: Chicago Thanksgiving Parade
events.venue: State Street from Ida B. Wells Drive to Randolph Street
events.summary: The Chicago Thanksgiving Parade on State Street. DCASE lists an 8 a.m. step-off, running from Ida B. Wells Drive to Randolph Street. The pin is a midpoint on that route.
events.transitNote: State Street from Ida B. Wells Drive to Randolph Street is the parade route, with an 8:00 a.m. start.
